D: A pushy book editor facing deportation forces her assistant to marry her, then meets his family in Alaska.
P: Serve the snacks when the family throws the welcome party in Sitka.
S: Rye crispbread with cream cheese, smoked salmon, dill and capers
Rye crispbread spread with cream cheese, topped with smoked salmon, dill and capers, finished with lemon.
Crab, cream cheese and spring onion baked until golden and bubbling
Crab meat mixed with cream cheese, mayo and spring onion, baked at 190C for 20 minutes until golden, with crackers.
Grandma Annie's honey berries and cream
Grandma Annie's chant in the woods

Blueberries and blackberries tossed with honey and lemon zest, spooned into small bowls over whipped cream. Toss 250g blueberries and 250g blackberries with 2 tbsp honey and the zest of 1 lemon and stand 10 minutes so the juices run. Whip 300ml cream with 1 tbsp icing sugar to soft peaks. Crush 4 shortbread biscuits. Spoon the cream into 4 small bowls, pile the berries and juice on top and scatter with the shortbread crumbs.
M: Roast salmon glazed with maple and wholegrain mustard, baby potatoes, green beans
Salmon fillets brushed with maple syrup and grainy mustard, roasted at 200C for 15 minutes, with buttered baby potatoes and green beans.
Barn wedding pot roast and horseradish
the wedding set up in the family barn

Beef chuck braised for 3 hours with onion, carrots and stock, potatoes added late, sliced with pot gravy and a sharp horseradish cream. Season a 1.5kg beef chuck roast and brown all over in a heavy pot. Add 2 quartered onions, 3 carrots in chunks, 2 garlic cloves, 1 tbsp tomato paste, thyme and 500ml beef stock. Cover and braise at 160C for 2 hours. Add 800g potatoes in chunks and braise 1 hour more. Lift out the beef and veg, thicken the liquid with 1 tbsp cornflour mixed with water and pour the gravy over the sliced beef. Mix 150g sour cream with 2 tbsp grated horseradish and a squeeze of lemon to serve on the side.
W: Butter sponge layers with strawberry jam and whipped cream, iced
Two vanilla sponges baked at 175C for 25 minutes, sandwiched with strawberry jam and whipped cream, iced white and topped with fresh flowers.
K: Espresso with vanilla bean syrup and milk over ice

Strong espresso poured over ice and cold milk with a vanilla bean syrup, served in takeaway cups for the walk into the office. Simmer 80g caster sugar with 80ml water and 1 split vanilla bean for 3 minutes, then cool. Make 4 double shots of espresso, or 300ml very strong coffee, and cool for 5 minutes. Fill 4 tall cups with ice, add 1 tbsp vanilla syrup and 200ml cold milk to each, then pour the espresso over the top. Stir and serve with lids and straws.

s.note: Rye crispbread with cream cheese, smoked salmon, dill and capers
s.how: Spread rye crispbreads with cream cheese. Top with folds of smoked salmon, a sprig of dill and a few capers. Squeeze over a little lemon just before serving. A taste of an Alaskan town for a reluctant New York visitor.

s.note: Crab, cream cheese and spring onion baked until golden and bubbling
s.how: Mix 250g crab meat with 250g cream cheese, 2 tbsp mayonnaise and sliced spring onion. Spread in a small dish and bake at 190C for 20 minutes until golden and bubbling. Serve hot with water crackers at the welcome party.

m.note: Roast salmon glazed with maple and wholegrain mustard, baby potatoes, green beans
m.how: Mix 2 tbsp maple syrup with a spoon of wholegrain mustard and brush over 4 salmon fillets. Roast at 200C for 15 minutes. Boil 800g baby potatoes and steam green beans, then toss both with butter. Serve together.

w.note: Butter sponge layers with strawberry jam and whipped cream, iced
w.how: Beat 250g butter with 250g sugar, add 4 eggs and fold in 250g self-raising flour. Bake in 2 tins at 175C for 25 minutes. Sandwich with strawberry jam and whipped cream, ice white and top with fresh flowers for a barn wedding.
